description: User reports getting 'You are not authorized' error when trying to run financial reports in SAP FICO module. Started this morning.
resolution: Checked user's role assignment in SU01. User was missing role Z_FI_REPORT_DISPLAY. Assigned role, ran SU53 to confirm, issue resolved after re-login.
title: User cannot access FI reports in SAP - authorization error

description: New hire in Finance team cannot open FI reports, gets authorization error message when running the transaction.
resolution: Role Z_FI_REPORT_DISPLAY was missing from the user's profile. Added it via SU01, confirmed with SU53 trace, resolved.
title: SAP FI report access denied for new user

description: Getting a permissions error trying to view finance reports today, worked yesterday, not sure what changed.
resolution: Missing authorization role for FI report display. Assigned Z_FI_REPORT_DISPLAY role in SU01. Fixed.
title: Unable to run financial report - permission error SAP

description: User gets authorization error on CO cost center reports, similar to the FI report issue but different module.
resolution: Root cause was similar to FI report issue but role needed was Z_CO_REPORT_DISPLAY, not the FI one. Assigned correct role, confirmed via SU53.
title: SAP authorization error when accessing controlling reports (CO module)

description: Internal SAP knowledge note describing how to use transaction SU53 to trace missing authorization objects when users report access-denied errors on reports.
resolution: Standard procedure: run SU53 immediately after the failed action, review missing auth object, cross-reference with role catalog, assign appropriate role via SU01, request user re-login to refresh buffer.
title: SAP Note: SU53 authorization trace usage for report access errors

description: SharePoint document listing standard SAP roles that should be provisioned for new Finance team members, including Z_FI_REPORT_DISPLAY and related reporting roles.
resolution: Reference checklist maintained by Finance IT liaison; used during new hire provisioning to ensure correct roles are requested from day one.
title: Finance Team Onboarding Checklist - SAP Access Requirements

description: Since the SAP role restructure last quarter, several Finance users are randomly losing access to reports they used to see.
resolution: Escalated to SAP Basis team - role restructure had unintended side effects, still being investigated across multiple business units.
title: Report access broken after SAP role restructure

description: User's VPN connection consistently drops after about 5 minutes of use. Attempting to reconnect fails with a timeout error.
resolution: Identified outdated VPN client version incompatible with Windows 11 update. Upgraded client to latest version, issue stopped recurring.
title: VPN drops after 5 minutes, reconnect fails on Windows 11

description: VPN keeps disconnecting randomly throughout the day, seems worse on video calls.
resolution: Same root cause as other recent VPN drop cases - outdated VPN client on Windows 11 machines. Updated client, resolved.
title: Intermittent VPN disconnects on laptop

description: Connection is fine for browsing but VPN drops whenever user tries to upload/download large files (100MB+).
resolution: Different root cause from typical VPN drop issue - this was an MTU size misconfiguration causing packet fragmentation on large transfers. Adjusted MTU setting, resolved.
title: VPN times out specifically during large file transfers

description: Employee working from home reports VPN is unstable, drops multiple times per hour, especially in the afternoon.
resolution: Traced to home router QoS settings deprioritizing VPN traffic. Advised user to adjust router settings; also flagged as possible ISP-side issue for that region.
title: Remote worker cannot maintain stable VPN connection

description: Standard troubleshooting steps for VPN connectivity issues: check client version, check MTU settings, check local network/router QoS, escalate to network team if unresolved after these steps.
resolution: Living document maintained by network team, updated quarterly with new known issues.
title: IT Knowledge Base - VPN Troubleshooting Guide

description: Employee tried logging in several times with wrong password, account is now locked.
resolution: Unlocked account via AD, reset password, sent temporary password securely, user confirmed access restored.
title: User locked out of account after failed login attempts

description: User forgot their password and cannot log into their workstation.
resolution: Reset password via self-service portal after identity verification, user regained access immediately.
title: Password reset request - forgot password

description: Same issue as usual, account locked after mistyping password too many times this morning.
resolution: Unlocked via AD console, verified identity by phone, confirmed resolved.
title: Account locked - too many login attempts

description: New hire's account was created but they never received their initial temporary password.
resolution: Regenerated temporary credentials, sent via secure channel to hiring manager for hand-off, confirmed login on first day.
title: New employee needs initial password setup

description: User's Outlook stopped receiving new emails since this morning, other apps work fine.
resolution: Outlook was stuck in cached mode with a corrupted OST file. Rebuilt OST file, sync resumed normally.
title: Outlook not syncing new emails

description: User notices emails arrive 2-3 hours late consistently, not immediate like before.
resolution: Exchange transport queue was backed up on one mail server node. Escalated to messaging team, resolved after queue was cleared.
title: Emails delayed by several hours in Outlook

description: User gets bounce-back error when trying to email attachments larger than 20MB.
resolution: This is expected behavior per company email size policy (20MB limit). Advised user to use SharePoint link sharing instead.
title: Cannot send emails with large attachments

description: User was granted access to a shared mailbox but it's not showing up in their Outlook.
resolution: Permissions had propagated in Exchange but Outlook needed a full restart (not just close/reopen) to pick up the new shared mailbox. Resolved after restart.
title: Shared mailbox not appearing in Outlook

description: The shared printer on the 3rd floor is not printing, shows as offline.
resolution: Printer had lost network connection after a power outage. Power cycled printer, reconnected to network, resolved.
title: Printer on 3rd floor not responding

description: employee laptop wont start, no lights nothing
resolution: replaced battery
title: Laptop won't turn on

description: External monitor connected via HDMI flickers on and off randomly throughout the day.
resolution: n/a
title: Monitor flickering intermittently

description: User's docking station stopped detecting both external monitors after a Windows update.
resolution: Docking station firmware was outdated and incompatible with the latest Windows display driver update. Updated dock firmware, resolved.
title: Docking station not detecting external monitors

description: New consultant starting Monday needs SAP GUI access but we're at license capacity.
resolution: Requested additional license from SAP license pool via procurement, provisioned within 2 business days.
title: Need additional SAP GUI license for new consultant

description: User's Adobe Acrobat Pro license shows as expired, cannot edit PDFs.
resolution: Renewed license through the software asset management portal, license key reactivated in software center.
title: Software license expired - Adobe Acrobat

description: Client requesting we remove Internet Explorer 11 dependency from legacy internal tool.
resolution: This references a deprecated system (IE11 was retired company-wide 2 years ago). Escalated to app modernization backlog, not a standard support fix.
title: Old version of software needs decommissioning

description: User reports 'access denied' when trying to open the project team SharePoint site.
resolution: User was never added to the SharePoint site's member group after joining the project. Added user to group, access restored within a few minutes for permission propagation.
title: Cannot access project SharePoint site

description: Several files that were in the shared library yesterday are no longer visible.
resolution: Files had been moved to a subfolder by another team member during a reorg, not actually deleted. Located files, informed user, no fix needed beyond navigation.
title: SharePoint document library missing files

description: Manager requesting access to compensation review documents on the HR SharePoint site for their direct reports.
resolution: Access granted after HR Business Partner approval, per compensation data access policy.
title: HR SharePoint site - salary review documents

description: The nightly inventory reconciliation batch job in SAP failed with a short dump overnight.
resolution: Short dump was caused by a database lock timeout during high-load window. Rescheduled job to run 30 minutes later, added retry logic. Resolved.
title: Nightly SAP batch job failed - inventory reconciliation

description: Guidance for diagnosing short dumps found in transaction ST22, common causes include lock timeouts, memory limits, and authorization issues in background processing.
resolution: Standard diagnostic flow: check ST22 for dump details, cross-reference SM37 job log, identify root cause category, apply matching fix pattern (reschedule/resize/reauthorize).
title: SAP Note: Handling ST22 short dumps for batch job failures

description: Monthly payroll summary report has been timing out for the past two cycles, previously ran fine.
resolution: Report was pulling an increasingly large dataset as headcount grew; needed a query optimization. Basis team added an index, runtime dropped from 40min to 3min.
title: Payroll report generation timing out

description: A data migration test run corrupted a small set of test records in the QA sandbox environment.
resolution: Root cause: manual script error during a one-time test migration; not a recurring pattern, isolated to test environment, no production impact.
title: Unusual one-off data corruption in test environment

description: After this week's Fiori launchpad update, the 'Purchase Order Approval' tile is missing from several users' home screens.
resolution: Currently under investigation with Basis and Fiori configuration team, appears related to a role-to-tile mapping issue introduced by the rollout. No confirmed fix yet.
title: New SAP Fiori app tile missing after latest rollout

description: Since installing a third-party SAP add-on for expense reporting, users report their SAP sessions time out much faster than usual.
resolution: Vendor confirmed a known bug in the add-on's session handling; waiting on vendor patch, workaround is to increase session timeout threshold temporarily.
title: Custom SAP add-on causing session timeouts

description: Official IT knowledge base article outlining the standard laptop imaging, software installation, and account provisioning steps for new employees.
resolution: Maintained by IT onboarding team, updated whenever the standard software bundle changes.
title: New Employee Laptop Setup Standard Procedure

description: Compliance team requesting a one-time export of all tickets related to a specific vendor for an external audit.
resolution: Exported requested ticket data via reporting tool, delivered securely to compliance team, no further action needed.
title: One-time request: export historical tickets for audit

description: CFO's laptop needs replacement, involves handling of confidential financial planning documents during migration.
resolution: Coordinated with executive support team for secure data migration and disposal of old device per confidentiality protocol.
title: Executive laptop replacement - confidential

description: Employee requesting correction of personal information (SSN typo) in HR system.
resolution: Corrected via HR system with HR admin approval, per data accuracy policy.
title: Employee personal data correction in HR system

description: Users in Finance report transaction ME23N taking much longer than usual to load, sometimes 30+ seconds.
resolution: Identified inefficient custom ABAP code in a user-exit tied to ME23N. Basis team optimized the code path, load time back to normal.
title: SAP transaction ME23N running slow for Finance team

description: User receives a workflow notification with a Excel attachment that fails to open.
resolution: Attachment was corrupted during a prior system migration. Regenerated the document from source, resolved.
title: Cannot open Excel attachment from SAP workflow

description: Team lead in HR requesting standard access to FBL3N for two new team members.
resolution: Reviewed role catalog, assigned matching standard role via SU01 after manager approval, confirmed access.
title: HR team requesting new SAP role for FBL3N access

description: Logistics team seeing repeated failed IDocs in WE02 related to interface processing.
resolution: Root cause was a mapping mismatch after a partner system update. Adjusted IDoc mapping configuration, reprocessed failed IDocs successfully.
title: Recurring SAP idoc processing errors in Logistics

description: Sales subfolder is not inheriting permissions correctly from the parent site.
resolution: Permission inheritance had been manually broken previously. Reset inheritance and reapplied group permissions, resolved.
title: SharePoint permissions inheritance broken for Sales folder

description: Finance users report printed output never arrives; spool requests in SP01 remain in waiting status on the default printer.
resolution: Cleared a jammed spool work process by restarting the spool service on the app server, then released the waiting requests in SP01.
title: SAP printer spool requests stuck in status waiting

description: After a monthly Windows patch, Outlook desktop search instantly returns zero results for all folders.
resolution: Rebuilt the Outlook search index via Indexing Options and re-enabled Windows Search integration in Outlook settings.
title: Outlook search returns no results after Windows update

description: Production import queue shows transports waiting for hours with a log full of background job delays.
resolution: Increased tp profile parameter for parallel imports and rescheduled the overlapping transport background jobs; queue drained in minutes.
title: SAP Note: Transport request stuck in import queue for hours

description: Vendor list view throws threshold errors after Procurement uploaded 6,000 legacy supplier rows in one batch.
resolution: Indexed the VendorID column, switched default view to filter by month, and advised batches under 5,000 items going forward.
title: Procurement SharePoint list throttled after bulk upload

description: Step-by-step guide for enrolling a personal phone into the mail profile with app protection policies applied.
resolution: Published the updated enrollment walkthrough including conditional-access screenshots and the new QR provisioning flow.
title: KB article: Setting up Outlook mobile with company mailbox

description: External contractors log into the Fiori launchpad but every tile renders an empty frame regardless of browser.
resolution: Launchpad content delivery cache was stale for the external user group; regenerated the semantic objects and cleared the cache.
title: SAP Fiori homepage tiles render blank for contractors

description: Design team moving 10 GB asset packages to the media agency sees throughput collapse at 2 MB/s over VPN.
resolution: Confirmed split tunneling was disabled by new policy; scoped an exception profile for the media agency IP range with security sign-off.
title: VPN split tunnel disabled for design team downloads

description: Billing documents in JPY show one-cent rounding variance against the accounting document for high item volumes.
resolution: Activated the rounding-difference adjustment routine for the JPY condition type and documented the reconciliation posting for finance.
title: SAP Note: Currency rounding differences in SD billing documents

description: Users with new USB-C docks lose the wired connection after the laptop wakes from sleep until the dock is unplugged.
resolution: Flashed the dock firmware to the latest build and enabled modern standby network wake in the laptop BIOS, connection now survives sleep.
title: Docking station ethernet drops when laptop sleeps

description: The inventory analytics tile in Fiori lags a full day behind the stock overview report numbers.
resolution: KPI data extraction job for the analytics stack was failing silently; rescheduled it and aligned the delta queue with the report source.
title: SAP Fiori analytics tile shows yesterday instead of live data
